title: Fix theme desync with global ThemeProvider + make Ritual History modal opaque

requirements.text: Implement a single global ThemeProvider/ThemeContext that stores `theme` ('light'|'dark'|'system') and `effectiveTheme` ('light'|'dark'), and centralizes all DOM theme class application (adding/removing `light`/`dark` on `document.documentElement`) in exactly one place.

quotes: Plan 4: Reactive Theme State + Guaranteed Sync

acceptanceCriteria: Theme state has one source of truth via a React context provider.
`document.documentElement.classList` is only mutated inside the ThemeProvider (not scattered across multiple hooks/components).
The provider exposes both `theme` and `effectiveTheme` to consumers.

requirements.text: Refactor the existing theme hook API so app code can continue using a hook to access theme state, but ensure there are no DOM reads during render and no duplicate system-theme listeners; only one system preference listener is active and only when `theme === 'system'`.

quotes: Add a `useSystemThemeWatcher` hook used only when theme==='system'.
Update ThemeToggle to consume context values instead of reading `document.documentElement.classList` during render.

acceptanceCriteria: ThemeToggle (and any other consumer) does not read `document.documentElement.classList` during render.
When `theme !== 'system'`, there is no active `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` change listener.
Switching OS light/dark while `theme === 'system'` updates `effectiveTheme` and the UI reactively without requiring a refresh.

requirements.text: Update ThemeToggle to use the ThemeContext values for rendering (including aria-label and icon state) and for toggling, eliminating icon/state desynchronization.
acceptanceCriteria: ThemeToggle icon and aria-label always match the currently applied theme (`effectiveTheme`).
Toggling the theme updates the UI immediately and correctly without needing a rerender triggered by unrelated state.

requirements.text: Ensure localStorage persistence for theme preference only happens in the explicit theme setter/toggle action (not on every render and not in effects that run repeatedly).

quotes: Keep localStorage writes only in the setter—not on every render/effect.

acceptanceCriteria: LocalStorage key `theme` is written only when the user changes theme (set/toggle).
Reloading the app restores the saved theme preference and applies it correctly.

requirements.text: Make the Home → Ritual History entry dialog readable by ensuring the dialog content surface is fully opaque (optionally with a subtle backdrop blur) in both light and dark themes, without editing any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose via className overrides at the call site).

quotes: Fix Home → Ritual History dialog readability: make modal sheet opaque (optionally with backdrop blur) instead of transparent; verify in light and dark mode

acceptanceCriteria: Opening a Ritual History entry on the Home page shows an opaque dialog surface (text is clearly legible) in light mode.
Opening a Ritual History entry on the Home page shows an opaque dialog surface (text is clearly legible) in dark mode.
No changes are made to any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`.

constraints: Do not modify any frontend files under the immutable paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not implement or change Insights computations, badge milestone persistence, or any backend logic unrelated to theme/modal fixes.
Do not add new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Do not redesign unrelated UI components or navigation behavior.
